description: Ability to add members to a group; add a controlled principal to a privileged group.

telemetry.detail: Member added to a security-enabled GLOBAL group - enabled by default in Security log.
Member added to a security-enabled LOCAL group.
Member added to a security-enabled UNIVERSAL group.
Privileged-group membership changes are a top-tier SOC alert; sensitive groups (Domain Admins, etc.) are almost always watched.

prerequisite_privilege: WriteProperty on the group 'member' attribute (or GenericAll/GenericWrite)
abuse_primitive: Add controlled user to the target group.
notes: 4728/4732/4756 are ON by default, unlike the 4662/5136 family. Adding to a flagged group (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins) is close to guaranteed detection - bump to 70+ for tier-0 groups.
